data.title: 丰川祥子 · 海边闭园后的蓝色灯串
data.description: 【闭园海滨舞台·傍晚】祥子穿着深蓝泳装外搭黑色薄衫，坐在空舞台边拆下一串灯饰；海风把蓝发两侧的发带吹起，她把最后一盏灯重新点亮，抬头看向镜头时笑容带着少见的轻松。
data.action: 闭园舞台边重新点亮最后一串蓝灯，海风吹起发带并轻松抬头
data.lighting: blue dusk with warm bulbs and ocean haze
data.mood: 演出结束后才属于自己的假日
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa sits at the empty seaside stage edge, untangling the blue light strand and getting its final bulb to glow. Her indigo swimsuit and black light overshirt remain clear as sea wind lifts her blue hair ribbons. The horizontal medium portrait includes the closed platform and ocean behind her rare relaxed smile. Blue dusk separates the stage from hazy water, while warm bulbs illuminate her hands and cast small cable shadows over the boards.
